positive.prompt: /firstmate Coordinate the API migration, client update, and independent verification across agents.
$firstmate Invoke the explicit-command AI orchestrator for this multi-service change.
/firstmate Act as the explicit-command-only AI orchestrator and keep delivery actions behind their authority gates.

negative.prompt: Implement the approved invitation feature in this isolated worktree.
Review this completed branch against its specification and repository standards.
Break the approved specification into dependency-aware implementation tasks.

evals.prompt: /firstmate Coordinate a database foundation, API migration, client update, and independent review. The user has authorized in-session delegation but has not authorized commits, pushes, pull requests, or merge.
evals.expected_output: A minimal dependency-aware crew plan with model tiers, bounded delegation contracts, independent verification, integration order, and explicit delivery authority boundaries, without direct implementation.
expectations: The First Mate inspects or requests the objective, repository constraints, active ownership, and acceptance evidence before dispatch.
The work is decomposed only where ownership and dependencies justify separate agents.
Each assignment contains objective, scope, constraints, acceptance criteria, verification, Git/delivery boundaries, and a return contract.
Model tiers follow complexity, uncertainty, blast radius, verification importance, and cost without inventing unavailable model names.
The database foundation precedes dependent API and client work, followed by integration proof and independent review.
No production file is edited and no commit, push, pull request, review reply, merge, or deployment is performed.
Completion depends on observed evidence rather than an agent merely returning.

evals.prompt: /firstmate The repository checks and required approvals are complete. Merge PR #42, which was made in /worktrees/api-migration. The user has authorized the merge but has not said whether to remove the worktree afterward.
evals.expected_output: The First Mate completes or delegates the authorized merge under the repository's integration convention, confirms it succeeded, then asks whether the user wants /worktrees/api-migration deleted (retired) without deleting it automatically.
expectations: The merge follows the repository's required integration and verification gates.
The worktree is not removed before or as an implied side effect of the merge.
After a confirmed merge, the First Mate explicitly asks the user whether to delete (retire) the identified worktree folder.
The response does not assume authority to delete the associated local or remote branch.

evals.prompt: /firstmate Clear the local worktrees for this repository. Retire the eligible folders, but one worktree may contain commits not yet merged into main.
evals.expected_output: The First Mate inventories and reviews the repository's local worktrees, retires only clean inactive folders whose commits are merged into the appropriate base, and escalates any unmerged worktree instead of deleting it.
expectations: Each candidate is checked for branch, working-tree state, ownership or active use, and merge ancestry against the appropriate integration base.
An unmerged candidate is preserved and reported with its folder, branch, commits, and intended base for the user's decision.
Unclear scope, active ownership, dirty state, or an unknown base pauses that candidate rather than treating it as eligible for deletion.
The cleanup request does not imply deletion of local or remote branches.
